Receiving outskirts will be separately overlaid around x25% y36%; compressed lane is not made yet.

NO bright accretion disk, no jet, no glowing black hole, no portal. Only surrounding dormant dusty material at upper edge, subdued dark central suggestion. Actual black-hole receiver and polar surroundings will be separately overlaid around x25%/75% y36%, so do not paint duplicate target objects there.
